kashika: श्लौ परतोऽनभ्यासस्य धातेरवयवस्य प्रथमस्यैकाचो द्वितीयस्य वा यथायोगं द्वे भवतः। जुहोति। बिभेति। जिह्रेति॥
kashikaEnglish: श्लु (third-class vikaraṇa) causes reduplication: जुहोति (हु), बिभेति, जिह्रेति.
englishShort: When a प्रत्यय is removed using the word श्लु, अङ्ग which is not yet duplicated is duplicated.
englishFull:
श्लौ — A non-reduplicated root is reduplicated when श्लु (vikaraṇa of 3rd class) follows.

श्लु causes elision of शप् and is the characteristic sign of the Juhotyādi (3rd) class.

Examples:
| Root | Class | Present 3rd sg. |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| हु | 3rd | जुहोति |
| भी | 3rd | बिभेति |
| ह्री | 3rd | जिह्रेति |
